analogy_headline: The silent leak under a green total
analogy_body: Imagine a chain of successful stores. Head-office sales look excellent. In a few locations a checkout glitch gives inventory away. Because the rest of the chain is strong, the company total stays green — and the leak never appears on the executive dashboard.

actionable_recommendations.title: Brief on masked losses, not only the net
actionable_recommendations.action: Require the weekly pack to list every segment loss above the critical threshold on days when company profit was still positive.

actionable_recommendations.title: Owner on every CRITICAL finding
actionable_recommendations.action: Assign Risk/Trading, Finance, Product, or Data Engineering with a due date before the next board risk review.

actionable_recommendations.title: Stop relying on a single company KPI
actionable_recommendations.action: Add segment materiality alerts so green company days cannot hide red cells.
